protocol.training: One pass per training seed; one revealed chosen outcome/update per eligible training context
protocol.validation: Report frozen-policy validation; no hyperparameter or checkpoint selection
protocol.test: Frozen greedy predicted-reward selector; no exploration bonus and no updates

reward.scope: Planning-model objective and gate only; AC audit is excluded

protocol.majority_tie_rule: Lexicographically smallest canonical SHA-256 operation ID
protocol.voting_terminology: Most-voted (plurality) operation; a three-way tie has no strict majority
protocol.best_of_all: Extra-budget audit reference over all unique actual response actions
protocol.latency: Accounted serial components, not measured online end-to-end deployment latency
protocol.claims: Small illustrative single-feeder pilot; no promised learned or language-model advantage

scope: Selected-feedback training replay only; held-out evaluation will follow after distinct final rechecks are available.
